scientific_question: Initial public-data feasibility and overlap audit
datasets: 13 GEO candidates including PE bulk/scRNA and hUC-MSC datasets
prespecified_rule: Traceable evidence; no guessed metadata; no overlap counted as independent
key_result: Repository and auditable registries established; GSE75010 overlap and GSE234729 discrepancies exposed
limitation: Candidate PE scRNA search was incomplete and was superseded by Phase 0B

scientific_question: Rescue PE scRNA availability and audit sender redundancy
datasets: Admati resources, GSE290578, Yang/Jiao/Zhang candidates, normal atlas, GSE182158/GSE199071/GSE117837
prespecified_rule: PRIMARY_PE_SCRNA requires accessible expression plus recoverable donor identity and valid comparison
key_result: Admati public matrix with 26 recoverable donors selected; sender redundancy documented
limitation: The nominal 78-subject preprint cohort was not reusable as the primary public analysis object

scientific_question: Freeze independent placental bulk cohorts and statistical design
datasets: GSE75010_BIOBANK, GSE30186, GSE10588, GSE24129, GSE25906, GSE43942
prespecified_rule: Independent cohorts analyzed separately; no cross-study pooling or ComBat
key_result: Six independent core cohorts frozen for cohort-wise synthesis
limitation: Clinical covariates and gestational-age matching were incomplete and heterogeneous

scientific_question: Correct preprocessing and freeze comparable primary estimands
primary_method: Raw-versus-processed audit; platform-appropriate reconstruction; formula freeze
prespecified_rule: No universal abs(meta log2FC)>=0.25 cutoff; retain all 18 QC flags
key_result: GSE30186 reconstructed without arbitrary shift-log; defensible matrices/formulas frozen
limitation: Several historical platforms required submitted processed matrices

scientific_question: Test for a stable gene-level PE signature across cohorts
primary_method: Cohort-wise limma plus REML random-effects meta-analysis and leave-one-cohort-out
prespecified_rule: FDR<0.05, >=75% direction, I2<=60%, LOO direction retained and >=80% LOO FDR<0.10
key_result: 17,731 genes estimable in >=4 cohorts; zero meta-FDR significant and zero STABLE genes
limitation: Cross-platform heterogeneity and limited covariate comparability precluded a universal gene signature

key_result: 20 SHARED_PE hypotheses and subtype-specific programs were generated
limitation: Public layer was normalized-to-about-10,000 and ceiled, not unmodified raw UMI counts

scientific_question: Stress-test legacy receiver hypotheses and audit confounding
primary_method: Clinical overlap tests, frozen-program scores, restricted sensitivities, Yang targeted replication
prespecified_rule: Do not refit non-estimable confounders or rediscover pathways
key_result: Delivery/IUGR positivity failures documented; partial Yang directional evidence; expression-layer contradiction confirmed
limitation: EOPE delivery mode and induction remained non-identifiable

scientific_question: Correct receiver framework and retest/rediscover programs
datasets: Admati normalized/ceiled public matrix; Zheng audit; preserved Yang evidence
primary_method: Donor mean normalized expression plus log transform and limma; corrected ranked gene-set testing
prespecified_rule: Tier 1 frozen-20 retest separated from exploratory corrected rediscovery
key_result: All 20 frozen hypotheses retained direction under the corrected model; 11 modules frozen; Zheng 3+2 cohort not reconstructable
limitation: Clinical confounding remained; external localization was sparse

scientific_question: Independently validate frozen receiver programs in bulk placenta
primary_method: Within-cohort rank scores, cohort disease models, random-effects program meta-analysis
prespecified_rule: Robust support required FDR<0.05, direction agreement, >=75% cohort agreement, I2<=60%, stable LOO direction
key_result: 19/19 sets estimable; zero robust constituent sets/modules; nine directional sets and five directional modules
limitation: Bulk supports tissue-level program direction, not cell-type localization

scientific_question: Define an independent reproducible hUC-MSC sender ligand universe
primary_method: Donor-aware baseline expression plus within-stratum licensing summaries
prespecified_rule: Robust baseline support across datasets/donors; licensing kept descriptive
key_result: 214 robust S1/S2 sender candidates frozen (38 S1; 176 S2)
limitation: Only two licensing donors and incomplete protein-level secretion evidence

scientific_question: Blindly integrate frozen sender and receiver arms
biological_replication_unit: ligand-receiver-module axis with pregnancy-level receptor competence
primary_method: NicheNet LR/targets plus generic signed OmniPath-CollecTRI layer
prespecified_rule: Separate compatibility from signed reversal; deterministic Tier A/B/C
key_result: 1,284 axes; 791 target-compatible, 63 reversal-supported, 246 disease-concordant; 17 generic-signed-prior Tier A candidates
limitation: Signed prior was generic; 12/17 Tier A candidates had mixed direction; Module 10 had zero target-compatible axes

scientific_question: Triangulate the frozen 17 with external topology, protein, perturbation, PE and novelty evidence
primary_method: Curated topology, candidate-specific literature/repository and perturbation audit
key_result: Initial audit found no TRIANGULATED_HIGH_PRIORITY candidate
limitation: Candidate-name-first retrieval missed proteins present only in proteomics tables; protein dimension superseded by 4B.1

scientific_question: Correct completeness of hUC-MSC protein-source evidence
datasets: Frozen 17; four technically evaluable UC/WJ-MSC extracellular proteomic resources
prespecified_rule: Only protein-source dimension updated; Phase 4B rules unchanged
key_result: 15/17 candidates detected in hUC-MSC EV material; none confirmed in complete soluble-CM tables; ENPP1 became sole TRIANGULATED_HIGH_PRIORITY candidate
limitation: EV evidence does not establish soluble secretion, placental exposure, direction, or efficacy
